plugins.title: Dialogue+
plugins.shortDescription: Add multiple NPC alternatives and choices.
plugins.fullDescription: Create ordered conditional dialogue and Yes/No choices for each NPC, with individual rewards and disappearance. Dialogue+ projects keep their conversations in local saves and standalone HTML exports.

plugins.title: Custom Themes
plugins.shortDescription: Seven editor palettes in a compact theme dropdown.
plugins.fullDescription: Adds a theme dropdown to the top left of the Editor tab. Choose Default, Darker, Dracula, Powershell, Light, Forest, or Sepia. The plugin remembers your selection in localStorage and restores it on startup, using Default when no valid selection is saved. Themes change editor colors without changing game artwork. Removing this trusted editor-only plugin restores the original colors and removes the dropdown.

plugins.title: Example plugin
plugins.shortDescription: Swap Tiles and NPCs to the top and hide World.
plugins.fullDescription: Moves Tiles to the top of the right column and NPCs to the top of the left column. Use Project > Plugins > Flip to restore their original positions. Hides the entire World section. Removal restores the layout. Runs trusted code in your editor only.

plugins.title: Maps+
plugins.shortDescription: Choose a world size from 1×1 to 5×5.
plugins.fullDescription: Adds synchronized row and column controls to the World panel and Project Plugins tab. Keeps the selected world size in local saves and standalone HTML exports.

plugins.title: Minimalist UI
plugins.shortDescription: A quieter editor with pixel-art catalogs and fewer labels.
plugins.fullDescription: Shows NPC, object, and enemy catalog artwork without names, descriptions, or stats. Hides World and enemy XP, starts Project collapsed with Information selected, and simplifies the pixel-art editor by hiding its header, effect label, and Paint/Erase buttons. Sprite editing and object configuration remain available. Use Escape or Save to close the pixel-art editor. Removing this trusted editor-only plugin restores the interface.

plugins.title: Variables+
plugins.shortDescription: Add 16 color-named boolean variables to a project.
plugins.fullDescription: Adds 16 boolean variables (var-17 through var-32) as soon as the plugin is installed. The extra slots are saved with the project and included in standalone HTML exports. Variables+ projects cannot use share URLs or online mode.
